import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

BOUND = pd.Timedelta(30, unit="s")
WINDOW = pd.Timedelta(5, unit="min")
GRID = pd.date_range("2024-01-01 00:00", "2024-01-01 00:10", freq="5min", tz="UTC")

def simulate(events, label):
    pos_wm = {}; fired_with = {}; fired = set()
    print(f"\n--- {label} ---")
    print(f"{'ev':>6} {'part':>4} {'event_time':>8} {'pos_wm':>8} {'glob_wm':>8} state")
    for e in events:
        p, et = e["partition"], e["event_time"]
        cand = et - BOUND
        if p not in pos_wm or cand > pos_wm[p]:
            pos_wm[p] = cand
        gwm = min(pos_wm.values())

        state = []
        for ws in GRID:
            if ws not in fired and gwm >= ws + WINDOW:
                fired.add(ws)
                fired_with[str(ws)[11:16]] = str(gwm)[11:19]
                state.append(f"FIRE {str(ws)[11:16]}")
        assigned_ws = et.floor("5min")
        if assigned_ws in fired and not any(s.startswith("FIRE") for s in state):
            state.append(f"LATE->{str(assigned_ws)[11:16]}(side-out)")
        print(f"{e['id']:>6} {p:>4} {str(et)[11:19]:>8} {str(pos_wm[p])[11:19]:>8} "
              f"{str(gwm)[11:19]:>8} {'; '.join(state) if state else 'buffered'}")
    print("fired:", {k: f"(gwm={v})" for k, v in fired_with.items()})
    return pos_wm
